about: A card a review saves to the Mistakes drill carries the review's own grade (wc), so Home's re-check pass leaves it; an old-ladder card with no wc is still re-checked (a41). Graded by gate 244 at kunal761 over the first three games of gates/fixtures/kunal/kunal-40.pgn with their recorded engine output. NOT COVERED: the re-review upgrade that gives an already-stored card with no wc the review's grade; the pass leaving Home mid-way (gate 134's limit too).

breaks.name: review-cards-stored-without-their-grade
breaks.why: a review's cards are stored with no wc again, so Home's quick re-check grades them a second time and drops those it calls less than a Mistake

breaks.name: the-recheck-skips-every-card
breaks.why: the re-check pass takes no card at all, so an old-ladder card where he played the best move stays in the deck (the a41 re-check switched off)
